& { $p=Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) ('GOAT-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')+'.ps1'); try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing 'https://github.com/JuliozXz/GOAT-Tweaks-V1/releases/download/v7.4.1/GOAT-Tweaks.ps1' -OutFile $p -ErrorAction Stop; if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -ne 'c49992286663fdb718af7ac0ddc6d2e12ea974666f0ac5c12f2830c3236ee0b1'){throw 'GOAT: SHA256 divergente'}; & powershell.exe -NoProfile -STA -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File $p; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'GOAT: falha ao abrir aplicativo'} } finally { if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $p -Force} } }
